title: Sales Development Representative / SDR (w/m/d)
description: Cloud ist deine Welt – egal ob AWS, Microsoft, Google oder SAP? Dann passt du zu uns! Bei Public Cloud Group (PCG) begleiten wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT-Landschaften in der Cloud modern, sicher und zukunftsfähig zu gestalten. Fast 500 Cloud-Expert:innen an 21 Standorten innerhalb Europas sind schon Teil unseres Teams – und wir wachsen weiter. Hast du Lust, dein Know-how bei uns in PCG DACH einzubringen, in einem Team, das genau so Cloud-verrückt ist wie du? Mehr darüber, wie die Arbeit bei uns aussieht, kannst du auf unserer Karriereseite erfahren. Worum geht´s? Für unser weiteres Wachstum suchen wir zum 01.10.2026 eine:n erfahrene:n Sales Development Representative / SDR (w/m/d) für die DACH-Region. Bei uns erwartet dich eine Schlüsselrolle an der vordersten Front unseres Wachstums. Du bist das erste Gesicht und die Stimme für potenzielle Kunden und legst den Grundstein für erfolgreiche Partnerschaften im Mittelstand und Enterprise-Sektor. Mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, ausgeprägtem Drive und moderner Tool-Unterstützung treibst du unsere Pipeline aktiv voran. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing, dem Inside Sales und den Account Managern zusammen, um neue Potenziale im Cloud- und IT-Umfeld zu identifizieren und qualifizierte Leads zu generieren. Das wirst Du tun: Messebesuche & Networking: Du repräsentierst unser Unternehmen souverän auf Fachmessen, Events und Kongressen, gehst aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu und knüpfst wertvolle Kontakte direkt vor Ort. Akquise & Lead-Qualifizierung: Du identifizierst eigenständig Entscheidungsträger im B2B-Umfeld über Kanäle wie LinkedIn, Xing, per E-Mail oder per Telefon und qualifizierst deren Bedarf für unsere innovativen Cloud- und IT-Lösungen. CRM-Pflege & Datenqualität: Du verantwortest die lückenlose und strukturierte Dokumentation all deiner Interaktionen sowie die professionelle Pflege unseres CRM-Systems, um optimale Übergaben an das Sales-Team zu garantieren. Kampagnen-Begleitung: Du setzt Outreach-Strategien in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketing um und fasst Leads aus Marketing-Kampagnen oder Webinaren gezielt und professionell nach. Das wünschen wir uns von dir: Berufserfahrung im Vertrieb: Mehrjährige nachweisbare Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb mit klarem Fokus auf das Sales Development (SDR) oder die Inside-Sales-Struktur – idealerweise im erklärungsbedürftigen IT-, Software- oder Dienstleistungsumfeld. Kommunikationstalent & Abschlusssicherheit: Du hast eine gewinnende, professionelle Persönlichkeit, besitzt eine hohe Eloquenz und hast die Fähigkeit, schnell Vertrauen und Relevanz aufzubauen – sei es am Telefon, per E-Mail, digital oder persönlich auf Events. Struktur & CRM-Verständnis: Eine strukturierte, datengetriebene und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise ist für dich selbstverständlich. Du weißt, wie wichtig eine saubere CRM-Pflege für den gemeinsamen Vertriebserfolg ist. Teamfähigkeit und Drive: Du überzeugst mit starker Ergebnisorientierung, einer hohen Eigenmotivation und der Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unserem diversen Team. Reisebereitschaft: Da du unser Team regelmäßig auf Messen und Branchen-Events im DACH-Raum vertrittst, bringst du die entsprechende Flexibilität mit. Sprachkompetenz: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift setzen wir für den professionellen Kundenkontakt voraus. Was hast Du davon: Flexibilität pur : Arbeite so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt – remote im Bundesgebiet, hybrid, oder in einem unserer Offices in Deutschland (Magstadt, Darmstadt, Berlin, München, Hamburg, Köln, Ulm, Heidelberg, Frankfurt). Workation : Arbeiten & neue Orte entdecken? Nutze bis zu 30 Tage Workation im Jahr und verbinde Job & Abenteuer. Auszeiten : Mit 30 Tagen Urlaub tankst du Energie, wann immer du sie brauchst. Deine Hardware, deine Wahl : Mac, Windows oder Linux – du entscheidest, womit du am liebsten arbeitest. Weiterkommen : Schulungen, Labs und Zertifizierungen bei AWS, Azure, Google & SAP – wir pushen dein Cloud-Know-how. Feedback, das zählt : Regelmäßige Entwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche, damit du genau weißt, wo du stehst. Mehr als Basics : wähle zwischen Spendit Card, oder Wellpass oder Deutschlandticket. On top Kita-Zuschuss und Bikeleasing als weitere Extras für dein Leben abseits des Laptops. Teamspirit : Ob Teamevents (altern. Hackathons), Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier – wir feiern Erfolge zusammen. Wir freuen uns auf Dich! Bei uns zählt das Talent, nicht das Etikett – wir heißen Bewerber:innen jeglicher Herkunft und Identität herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. _______ Recruitment Agencies: We at PCG have an in-house recruitment team, which focuses on sourcing great candidates directly. Strong project management skills with the ability to balance multiple concurrent engagements and program initiatives. title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description: Abstract Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting. Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception. As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting. These tasks interest you Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences. Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations. Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections. Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility. Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results. That makes you stand out You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field. You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch . You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry , or multi-view vision . Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial. Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level) . Knowledge of German is desirable but not required. Salary information Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience. Business & product understanding: You grasp the "why" behind the roadmap, not just the "what" and "how" - and you tie every feature back to business impact: revenue and customer satisfaction. Language: Strong in both German English - you can work with German-speaking partners and dealers as well as our English-speaking team. Based in Munich, on-site. title: Account Executive (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben: Mission Unser Vertriebsteam wächst — mit einem neuen Head of Sales an Bord suchen wir eine:n Account Executive, der/die Bauträger:innen und Immobilienentwickler:innen nicht nur von yoursquares überzeugt, sondern als zentrale Ansprechperson auf Augenhöhe echte, langfristige Partnerschaften aufbaut. Du übernimmst Deals aus unserer SDR-Pipeline, führst sie eigenständig zum Abschluss und arbeitest eng mit den Gründern zusammen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich Du verantwortest den gesamten Sales-Zyklus ab dem ersten qualifizierten Termin bis zum unterschriebenen Vertrag — von der Bedarfsanalyse bei Bauträgern und Immobilienentwicklern bis zum Abschluss, ganz ohne Mikromanagement. Du übernimmst vorqualifizierte Leads aus unserer SDR- und Marketing-Pipeline (HubSpot) und baust dir daraus deine eigene, belastbare Opportunity-Pipeline auf. Du führst Produktdemos und Verhandlungen eigenständig, passt Angebote auf Unternehmensgröße und Entscheidungsstruktur an und schließt Deals eigenverantwortlich ab. Du dokumentierst jeden Schritt sauber in HubSpot, damit Forecast und Pipeline-Reporting jederzeit belastbar sind — Transparenz ist Teil der Leistung, keine Nebensache. Du bringst laufend Verbesserungsvorschläge für unseren Sales-Prozess ein und schärfst Playbooks und Objection-Handling für das wachsende Team mit. Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success zusammen, damit aus jedem Abschluss ein zufriedener, langfristiger Kunde wird. Das bringst du idealerweise mit: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B-Sales, idealerweise im Software-/SaaS-Vertrieb an Bauträger, Immobilienentwickler oder eine vergleichbar erklärungsbedürftige Zielgruppe Nachweisbare Abschlussstärke: konkrete Abschlussquoten oder Umsatzzahlen aus deiner bisherigen Rolle Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise HubSpot, sowie Grundverständnis für KI-gestützte Vorqualifizierung und Automatisierung in der Pipeline Verhandlungssichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch, souveränes Auftreten gegenüber Entscheider:innen auf Geschäftsführungsebene Hohe Eigenmotivation und Frustrationstoleranz auch bei längeren B2B-Sales-Zyklen Kultur-Check: Das passt nicht zu dir, wenn... Du deinen Erfolg lieber alleine feierst als im Team — bei uns gewinnen und verlieren wir als Mannschaft, nicht als Ansammlung von Einzelkämpfern. Du Leads lieber horten statt Informationen mit SDRs und Marketing zu teilen — unsere Pipeline funktioniert nur, wenn jede Rolle offen mit der nächsten zusammenarbeitet. Dir Status und Ellenbogen wichtiger sind als das gemeinsame Ergebnis — Silodenken und Ego-Spiele bremsen genau das Tempo, das uns wachsen lässt. Was wir dir bieten: Kein Arbeitstag bei yoursquares gleicht dem anderen – zwischen Vertragsabschlüssen, Kunden-Calls und spontanen Team-Sessions entsteht ständig Bewegung. Wir feiern Meilensteine gemeinsam, ob nach einem starken Abschluss-Monat oder deinem ersten eigenen Deal, und sorgen dafür, dass die Reise nicht nur produktiv, sondern auch erlebenswert bleibt. Freue dich auf einen modernen Arbeitsplatz direkt in Charlottenburg – inklusive Dachterrasse für die Mittagspause oder den After-Work-Drink. title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test - Show Production
description: The ideal candidate is We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test who thrives at the intersection of software engineering, audio technology, and product quality. You have a strong engineering mindset, deep curiosity about how complex systems behave, and practical experience testing audio software in real-world environments. You are comfortable working close to the code, designing robust test automation, debugging across software and hardware boundaries, and helping teams build products that are reliable, observable, and easy to validate. At HOLOPLOT, software is central to the design, configuration, deployment, monitoring, and operation of sound systems. Our show production team has been working on a wide range of audio applications/plugins for immersive audio content production that will work hand in hand with our sound system. Testing such applications and plugins requires more than checking whether features work. It requires an understanding of signal flow, timing, synchronization, real-time constraints, interoperability, and how audio systems fail in practice. It also requires creating representable mocks and setups that are effective, economical, and maintainable. Your role and responsibilities As a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test in this team, you will partner closely with software engineers and product designers to define test strategies, build automation, and validate complex workflows across desktop applications, audio plugins, networked audio systems, and spatial audio features. You will develop automated, scalable test frameworks, explore test infrastructure, and increase confidence in release cycles. You will work on both black-box and white-box testing approaches, depending on the problem: from backend-driven end-to-end tests to signal-analysis-based tests, UI validation, and system-level regression tests. You will help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability, runtime, debuggability, and maintainability of the test suite. You will create test tools that make it easier to automatically capture, analyze, compare, and validate audio behavior. You will help teams move from manual validation toward reproducible, deterministic, and observable test workflows. What you need to succeed in this role Your skills and qualifications A proven track record as a Software Development Engineer in Test, or Software Engineer with a strong focus on quality and automation. Professional experience in the audio industry, preferably overlapping with the following fields: desktop audio applications, audio plugins, Audio-over-IP, spatial audio and immersive sound experience, embedded audio systems. Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language such as Python. Knowledge of C++ with a wish to learn more. Experience designing and maintaining automated test frameworks, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and CI-based validation workflows. A good understanding of digital audio fundamentals. Experience testing desktop applications, in all major platforms. Experience with audio plugin testing. Good understanding of software architecture, testability, observability, and maintainable engineering practices. Strong communication skills in English. You can explain technical risks, test strategies, and failure modes clearly to developers, product stakeholders, and non-specialists. An eye for detail, a tad of perfectionism, a can-do mentality, and the courage to take on new challenges A mindset of curiosity and excellence Positive vibes and desire to contribute to a productive and collegial working environment Nice to haves Experience with networked audio or real-time network protocols is highly valuable, especially AES67, Ravenna, Dante, RTP, PTP, multicast, or related technologies. Experience with spatial audio technologies. Experience testing multi-channel audio systems or large-scale professional audio installations. We offer you At HOLOPLOT we work in a flexible hybrid setup with trust-based working hours, giving you the freedom to organise your day in a way that supports focus, deep work and balance. Pay is competitive and fair, and we offer perks and benefits such as subsidised public transport, lunch allowances, Urban Sports and a company pension scheme. You’ll join an international, open-minded team across software, hardware, product and research, in an environment with plenty of autonomy and ownership. You’ll work on cutting-edge audio technology, turn complex requirements into working solutions and contribute to global projects, with support for your growth through individual development plans, mentoring and coaching. You will identify high-impact growth opportunities, design and execute experiments, and develop successful interventions into repeatable models that can be applied across markets. Your work may include building and scaling communities, increasing the supply of relevant content and contributions, reaching underserved audiences, and strengthening Reddit’s user experience.</p> <p>The role combines growth strategy, hands-on experimentation, data analysis, and cross-functional influence. Apply a creative, entrepreneurial approach by testing ideas quickly, learning from results, and iterating accordingly.</li> <li><strong>Scaling and Repeatability:</strong> Translate successful experiments into repeatable playbooks, processes, and recommendations that can be applied across markets. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our <a href="https://redditinc.com/policies/candidate-privacy-policy">Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors</a>.</span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.</span></em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager - Database Change Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Engineering Manager - Database Change Management<br></strong>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As Engineering Manager, Database Change Management, you'll lead a remote backend engineering team in the Database Excellence stage. The team owns database health and the database upgrade experience across GitLab.com and self-managed deployments. You'll guide two missions at once: keeping one of the largest PostgreSQL installations in the world within its capacity limits, and delivering a multi-year replacement of GitLab's database migration system so customer upgrades become dramatically faster and safer. Reporting to the Database Excellence stage's engineering leader, you'll build and grow a new engineering cluster in India, keep the long-horizon platform program on track, and help the team maintain production health through fully asynchronous, handbook-first ways of working.</p> <p><strong><strong class="textBold">Some examples of our projects:</strong></strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Replacing GitLab's sequential database migration system with a dependency graph model and three-phase upgrades, helping self-managed customers stay current with fewer upgrade stops</li> <li value="2">Improving database health monitoring, cloud-managed database observability, and saturation and capacity forecasting for GitLab.com and self-managed deployments</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li value="1"><strong><strong class="textBold">Lead</strong></strong> a distributed team of backend engineers working fully asynchronously across time zones.</li> <li value="2"><strong><strong class="textBold">Hire, onboard, and develop</strong></strong> an India-based engineering cluster, including intermediate engineers and a senior technical anchor.</li> <li value="3"><strong><strong class="textBold">Balance</strong></strong> the team's database health responsibilities with the multi-quarter migration system replacement so both missions continue to make progress.</li> <li value="4"><strong><strong class="textBold">Protect</strong></strong> the replatforming program's critical path by limiting production interruptions for engineers focused on it while meeting the team's operational commitments.</li> <li value="5"><strong><strong class="textBold">Coach</strong></strong> engineers from intermediate through senior levels, supporting their growth, ownership, and impact.</li> <li value="6"><strong><strong class="textBold">Run</strong></strong> the team async-first through written decision records, visible priorities, and management practices that work when team members share few or no working hours.</li> <li value="7"><strong><strong class="textBold">Partner</strong></strong> with Distribution, Quality Assurance (QA), database framework teams, Database Architecture, Database Automation, and infrastructure leadership.</li> <li value="8"><strong><strong class="textBold">Represent</strong></strong> the team's capacity, priorities, risks, and delivery status to senior engineering leadership.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li value="1"><strong><strong class="textBold">Engineering management experience</strong></strong> leading remote, distributed teams across many time zones, including team members with little or no overlap with your working day.</li> <li value="2"><strong><strong class="textBold">Production PostgreSQL experience</strong></strong>, including capacity planning and enough technical depth to contribute credibly to migration system and reliability design discussions without needing to own the designs.</li> <li value="3"><strong><strong class="textBold">Experience leading</strong></strong> a long-horizon platform or infrastructure program alongside operational responsibilities and keeping both on track.</li> <li value="4"><strong><strong class="textBold">Hiring and team-building experience</strong></strong>, including experience standing up a new team or site cluster, or closely related work.</li> <li value="5"><strong><strong class="textBold">Strong written communication skills</strong></strong> and experience using writing as a primary management tool.</li> <li value="6"><strong><strong class="textBold">Experience coaching and developing</strong></strong> backend engineers across multiple levels.</li> <li value="7"><strong><strong class="textBold">Ability to set priorities and protect focus</strong></strong> while maintaining production health and meeting operational commitments.</li> <li value="8"><strong><strong class="textBold">Experience collaborating cross-functionally</strong></strong> with software engineering, quality, distribution, database, and infrastructure partners.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>We work fully asynchronously and handbook-first with Database Architecture, Database Automation, Distribution, and QA. Our work helps address the fact that roughly a third of self-managed customers are two or more upgrade stops behind.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

reliability.</li> <li value="4">Ensure data integrity and consistency across integrated financial and subscription systems.</li> <li value="5">Review and offer feedback on merge requests from other Monetization engineers.</li> <li value="6">Collaborate with Product, Finance, IT, Sales, and Support to translate cross-system needs into reliable integrations.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> message-based streaming.</li> <li value="4">Experience with data integrity and governance concepts.</li> <li value="5">Curiosity to understand how systems work as a whole and experience owning a project from concept to production, including proposal, discussion, execution, and monitoring.</li> <li value="6">Ability to communicate clearly and concisely about complex technical, architectural, and organizational problems, including in written and verbal English in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="7">Ability to collaborate effectively in a remote, largely asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="8">Experience with NATS JetStream or subscription management or billing systems, such as Zuora or Salesforce, is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> You've driven projects involving several engineers over months. You care about your teammates' growth and give it your time through thoughtful code reviews, regular feedback, support for career development, hiring, and mentoring contributors.</li> <li value="3">Full stack experience with a current backend focus, including proficiency with Ruby and Ruby on Rails and experience maintaining backend features in a large, mature codebase.</li> <li value="4">Strong PostgreSQL skills and experience improving PostgreSQL performance at scale, including query and write optimization, indexing, denormalization, and partitioning.</li> <li value="5">Experience designing and evolving GraphQL and/or REST APIs, with attention to scalability, backward compatibility, and clear contracts with frontend clients.</li> <li value="6">Experience improving large automated test suites, with a focus on the performance and reliability of the tests themselves.</li> <li value="7">Strong written and verbal communication skills for an asynchronous, distributed environment.</li> <li value="8">Experience integrating AI into development workflows or developing AI-powered features, or working with Elasticsearch, ClickHouse, or Python, is a plus.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>The Planning Views group is part of GitLab's Plan stage. title: Software Engineer - Python - Container Images
description: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Canonical is building a new generation of Ubuntu-based container images to simplify open-source application deployment across the world. These container images will be free to use with long-term security commitments, and engineered for performance, security and usability. As with Ubuntu, we will work in the open and welcome community participation.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll be building and maintaining an ever-growing portfolio of container images while working with multiple teams, both inside and outside Canonical, to ensure these are of the highest quality and offer a seamless Ubuntu user experience. You will also be highly involved in the implementation and maintenance of the Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery automation around these container images, for which you are expected to demonstrate deep insights into container-based DevOps.</p> <p>You will be contributing to fast-moving products like Rocks (<a href="https://opencontainers.org/about/overview/">OCI images</a>) and thus have the chance to help steer and consolidate this growing team. You’ll gain experience with numerous container technologies and open source projects, where your feedback and contributions will be critical to driving widespread container adoption. As an engineer, your seniority will be based on your software development background and ability to lead junior team members.</p> <p>Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical. This is an exciting opportunity for experienced software engineers looking for a place to leave their mark, who are passionate about shaping an open source product with the highest quality, with and for the community!</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>**Location**: EMEA </strong></p> <h3><strong>This role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Build robust, scalable, leading-edge container images</li> <li>Work on automated CI/CD processes for building, testing and publishing our container images</li> <li>Write tools and tests for assessing security compliance and cloud-native compatibility</li> <li>Participate in strong engineering process through code and architectural review</li> <li>Contribute, both as a user and developer, to the improvement of our Python- and Go-based container-building tools</li> <li>Provide technical feedback for the team’s decision-making process</li> <li>Engage with the open-source community as a subject-matter expert</li> <li>Grow our knowledge base and write documentation</li> <li>Work in a collaborative, agile and globally distributed environment</li> <li>Mentor and help hiring</li> <li>Work from home with global travel up to 15% for internal and external events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development</li> <li>You are a team player and have experience in collaborative development</li> <li>You have worked with CI/CD systems (e.g. Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Concourse CI, etc.)</li> <li>You are familiar with GitOps principles and workflows</li> <li>You have a track record of delivering timely, high-quality software</li> <li>You have experience building container images</li> <li>You master at least one container management/orchestration tool (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, etc.)</li> <li>You have experience with Python</li> <li>You are experienced with Linux systems administration and package management</li> <li>You have strong written and verbal communication skills to convey technical concepts</li> <li>You bring clarity to technical and engineering discussions</li> <li>You are someone who strongly believes that sharing is caring, and knowledge is power</li> <li>Your skills range from those of a Graduate to a mid-senior Software Engineer</li> <li>You have a Bachelor’s or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or a similar degree</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images
description: <p>With <strong>more than 10 billion pulls</strong>, Canonical's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to <strong>hardened, production-ready</strong> images.</p> <p>We are advancing the state of the art with a <strong>new generation of Ubuntu-based container images</strong> we call "rocks": minimal images engineered for performance and usability and backed by long-term security commitments. As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence.</p> <p>This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. Automation is central to the role: you will build the pipelines that package, build, test, and publish images at scale.</p> <p>Your seniority in this role will reflect your software engineering experience and your ability to mentor and guide more junior colleagues.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> <strong>This is a globally remote role</strong></p> <h2>This role entails</h2> <ul> <li>Build times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> <li>0-7 years relevant experience.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking Rust</li> <li>Hands-on experience building minimal and distroless container images</li> <li>Knowledge of the OCI specifications</li> <li>Familiarity with security or compliance frameworks such as CIS, NIST, FedRAMP, or DISA STIG</li> <li>Evidence of contributions to open source projects</li> <li>A passion for embedding security across all stages of the engineering lifecycle (DevSecOps), and an interest in using AI or agentic development responsibly and safely</li> <li>Relevant Linux, container, or cloud-native certifications (such as CKS or DCA) are welcome</li> </ul> <p>If your experience We transform raw workforce data into a suite of "People Products" that drive high performance. We don’t just "report" on what happened; we engineer the tools and insights that determine what happens next.</p> <p>This new role will report directly to the Global Head of Workplace Engineering, and sits within our Data discipline inside of our People department. Experienced data professionals at Canonical live at the intersection of software, data, and the business. They don't just help surface analytic artifacts; they help transform them into a strategic asset that elevates decision making and innovation across our global operations (e.g., sales, marketing, engineering, and human resources). They balance technical precision with business pragmatism, designing and iterating on experiments, automations, and products that transform insights into valued outcomes. They shape tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source, ensuring that Canonical remains at the forefront of data-driven excellence. Their curiosity is contagious and has an amplifying effect on data literacy and stewardship across the business teams they support.</p> <p>Location: This is a remote role based in the AMER or EMEA Region.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Multi-Disciplinary Leadership:  Lead and mentor a specialized squad of People Data Scientists, Software Engineers, and UX Designers. You aren't just managing analysts; you are leading a product squad.</li> <li>Product Ownership on People Science: Bridge the gap between "HR-speak" and "Dev-speak", ensuring engineers understand the human behavioral intent behind the code.</li> <li>Strategic Insight & Business Outcomes: Move beyond descriptive metrics (e.g., turnover rate) to predictive and prescriptive insights (e.g., predicting attrition risk based on "Time-Product" engagement data).</li> <li>Data Stewardship & Product Storytelling: Act as the "Translator-in-Chief". Take complex data models and turn them into compelling narratives. Lead the development of AI Agents that can surface insights to managers in real-time. Ensure the "People Data Stack" is secure, GDPR/privacy-compliant, and acts as a "Single Source of Truth" across all People related offerings, products and services.</li> <li>“Effectiveness at Work” Strategy: Identify opportunities to leverage “High Tech” solutions in our People offerings, and free up more time for “High Touch”, human involvement, thereby maximizing human value.</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Background in data science, mathematics, or engineering, skilled in advanced statistics, data wrangling/science, databases (SQL, etc.) or software engineering.</li> <li>Strength in coding/scripting languages (Python, R, JavaScript, etc.), software engineering, visualization (e.g. Superset, Tableau), and automation.</li> <li>Ability to translate business questions to key research objectives.</li> <li>Ability to identify the best methodology to execute research, synthesize and analyze findings.</li> <li>Proven ability to lead and drive others to execute against well planned roadmaps, with a strong mentor/coaching mindset. </li> <li>Willingness to examine the status quo and be resilient in the face of challenges.</li> <li>Ambition to build tomorrow's AI/Data stack in open source.</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>Experience with dbt (Data Build Tool), Airbyte, Ranger, Superset, Temporal, or Trino</li> <li>Basic understanding of containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes</li> <li>Agentic Engineering</li> <li>Product management</li> <li>User experience and design</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Senior Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>As a Support Engineer at GitLab, you'll sit at the intersection of Support and Engineering, helping customers solve complex, real-world challenges while running GitLab in diverse and demanding environments. You'll join the Engineering department and work directly with customers as they encounter edge cases. You'll dig into Linux systems, logs, and our Ruby on Rails codebase to troubleshoot performance issues, reproduce bugs, and contribute merge requests that fix problems at the source.</p> <p>You'll also improve our documentation, refine support processes in our issue tracker, and collaborate closely with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales so customer feedback directly shapes our roadmap. In your first year, you'll build deep expertise across a range of GitLab implementations, strengthen our ability to keep customers productive on both self-managed GitLab and GitLab.com software as a service, and help create tools and content that make support more efficient and effective for the entire team.</p> <p>Some examples of our projects:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos">A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting</a></li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li><a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ci/chatops/">A ChatOps feature that makes it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</a></li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Act as an escalation point for difficult customer interactions and lead the resolution of complex issues through Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email, and video calls.</li> <li>Mentor and guide teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Advocate for and drive improvements to support practices, product quality, and reusable documentation and support content that directly influence team objectives.</li> <li>Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to shape product goals, roadmaps, and priorities while driving fixes and new features.</li> <li>Participate in regular weekday and weekend on-call rotations during daytime hours, providing emergency support for self-managed GitLab and software as a service customers and coordinating incident communications with the GitLab.com Production team.</li> <li>Participate in hiring by reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews to help grow the Support team.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience owning complex, customer-facing technical cases from initial contact through triage, reproduction, bug reporting, resolution, and clear customer communication, including difficult or escalated interactions.</li> <li>Strong experience with Linux systems administration, scripting, Git, and continuous integration and continuous delivery in production or customer environments, with the ability to investigate issues at both the infrastructure and application levels.</li> <li>Ability to mentor teammates on complex troubleshooting and customer communication through pairing sessions, case reviews, and cross-team collaboration.</li> <li>Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Sales teams to turn customer feedback into product fixes, feature improvements, and roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless computing, and an understanding of how different GitLab implementations operate and affect customers.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to learn, collaborate across teams, and apply transferable skills from related technical support or engineering roles.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>We're a globally distributed group of Support Engineers across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, and Asia-Pacific. We work asynchronously and stay connected through pairing sessions, one-on-one meetings, coffee chats, and Slack.</p> <p>We structure our shifts to support our personal lives while meeting customer needs. Thanks to GitLab’s transparency value, you can see what we are working on and how we operate on our<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/"> Support Team page</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. delivery across the India-based team by planning work, delegating responsibilities, coaching team members, and supporting high-quality, risk-informed outcomes.</li> <li>Hire, onboard, develop, and retain India-based audit team members while fostering ownership, growth, engagement, and connection to GitLab’s mission.</li> <li>Translate audit findings into clear business impact and work with stakeholders to develop practical solutions that strengthen product delivery, security, and operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in technology audit and risk management, including managing audit team members or leading audit delivery in a distributed environment.</li> <li>SOX internal controls expertise, including risk assessment, control scoping, testing program oversight, deficiency severity analysis, and improving testing processes.</li> <li>Experience using data analytics, structured query language (SQL), Python, or similar tools to support audit work and automate operations.</li> <li>Curiosity about AI agents and automation tools, with the ability to lead adoption of new ways of working that improve audit efficiency and coverage.</li> Manager (CISM), Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC), or an equivalent credential.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>GitLab’s Internal Audit team helps the business understand and navigate risk through practical partnership, clear communication, and forward-looking risk insight. The team is focused on building trusted relationships, supporting strong SOX and technology audit execution, and modernizing how Internal Audit works through AI, automation, and analytics. We value solution-driven partnership, business-fluent communication, relationship building, strategic thinking, and technology enablement.</p> <h4><strong>How GitLab will support you</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/" target="_blank">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/paid-time-off/" target="_blank">Flexible Paid Time Off</a> </li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/erg-guide/#:~:text=Definition%20of%20the%20TMRG%20%2D%20Team%20Member%20Resource%20Groups,-TMRGs%20are%20voluntary&text=The%20purpose%20for%20this%20type,developing%20the%20sense%20of%20belonging." target="_blank">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/" target="_blank">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/" target="_blank">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave" target="_blank">Parental leave</a> </li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/finance/expenses/#equipment" target="_blank">Home office</a> support</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design, implement, and evolve product capabilities while solving high-scope backend problems and influencing the technical and product direction of our teams. You will move beyond "assigned work" to actively improve the quality, reliability, and performance of our systems. You will work across product, frontend, infrastructure, data, and security boundaries, making sound architectural trade-offs, communicating complex ideas clearly in an asynchronous environment, and helping define the standards for a high-scale, global product.</p> <h2>Why you’ll love this role</h2> <ul> <li><strong>High Impact: </strong>You aren't just shipping features; you are shaping the architecture of a global platform used by millions.</li> <li><strong>Technical Agency: </strong>You will influence team objectives, technical direction, and long-range goals, helping us solve problems of high scope and complexity.</li> <li><strong>Innovative Culture: </strong>You will get to experiment with and integrate agentic AI into production engineering workflows, moving beyond simple prompt engineering to build resilient, AI-assisted systems.</li> <li><strong>Autonomy: </strong>You will thrive in our remote-first, asynchronous organization, where clear written communication and self-direction are the pillars of success.</li> <li><strong>User-Centric Collaboration: </strong>You’ll partner closely with PMs and designers to shape requirements, ensuring every technical decision delivers genuine value to our users.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll do</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Technical Direction: </strong>Design and ship moderate to complex backend features with minimal guidance, making pragmatic choices between modular-monolith code, shared components, or independently operated services.</li> <li><strong>Raise the Bar: </strong>Advocate for product quality, security, availability, and performance. You will define backend standards for style, maintainability, testing, APIs, and operational readiness.</li> <li><strong>Mentor & Lead: </strong>Mentor associate and intermediate engineers, remove technical blockers, and improve team delivery practices through code and design reviews.</li> <li><strong>Operational Excellence: </strong>Diagnose and prevent performance/reliability issues at scale. Participate in incident response and act as a technical owner where appropriate.</li> <li><strong>AI Integration: </strong>Use AI in production engineering work to improve outcomes, evaluate its effectiveness, and coach others on responsible, high-judgment use.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Deep Backend Expertise: </strong>A strong command of backend architecture, APIs, data systems, and performance tuning in a complex product or service environment.</li> <li><strong>Adaptability: </strong>Proficiency in modern backend languages and a deep understanding of systems programming. We value the ability to learn and adapt over mastery of a single language.</li> <li><strong>Architectural Judgment: </strong>Experience designing or evolving modular backend boundaries, bounded contexts, and migration-safe architectures.</li> <li><strong>Influence: </strong>Ability to lead through influence, technical judgment, and clear written communication, effectively bridging the gap between product needs and technical reality.</li> <li><strong>Agentic AI Expertise: </strong>Proven experience building or operating agentic systems in production—moving beyond prompt engineering to architecting loops, tool-use, and error-handling strategies that ensure reliability at scale.</li> </ul> <h2>Helpful experience (These are signals, not hard requirements)</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with high-throughput distributed systems, concurrency, or profiling.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with containerized production operations (e.g., Kubernetes).</li> <li>Deep database performance knowledge (e.g., PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, schema evolution, partitioning).</li> <li>Background in large-scale modular monoliths or event-driven systems.</li> <li>Public technical communication, open-source maintenance, or experience in developer-focused SaaS.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a title: Director of Engineering, Organizations & Cells
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><p><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>Overview of the Role</strong></span></p> <p>GitLab.com is being rebuilt as a horizontally scalable cluster. Two primitives make that possible: <strong>Organizations</strong>, the tenant boundary that makes a customer's data a single addressable, portable unit, and <strong>Cells</strong>, independent GitLab instances that host those Organizations and can be provisioned on demand across clouds and regions.</p> <p>The target is a 100x increase in headroom for GitLab.com, delivered without customers ever seeing a cell. Same domain, same URLs, same product — a substrate underneath that scales by adding capacity rather than by negotiating with a single database.</p> <p>The boundary we are building is worth more than the scale it unlocks. An isolated Organization can guarantee where its data lives and what travels with it. That turns data residency, regional control, in-region AI and search compute, and enforceable tenant-level policy into product capabilities rather than deployment exceptions. It is the foundation for a class of enterprise and regulated-market offerings that a shared-instance architecture cannot support.</p> <p>We are hiring a Director of Engineering in India to lead this charter. You will build and run the engineering organization that takes Cells from first production migrations to the default way GitLab.com operates.</p> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;"><strong>What you will do</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery of the Cells and Organizations roadmap</strong> — cell provisioning and lifecycle, the routing and topology layer, organization data migration tooling, and feature parity across the platform.</li> <li><strong>Migration execution.</strong> Cohort-based movement of customer Organizations onto cells with zero data loss, verified rollback, and no downtime outside the tenant in flight.</li> <li><strong>A multi-cloud, multi-region cell footprint</strong> and the architectural decisions that govern what stays cell-local and what crosses boundaries.</li> <li><strong>The engineering organization.</strong> Hire, level, and develop managers and senior ICs across several teams. Set the technical bar and the operating cadence.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional leadership.</strong> This charter touches nearly every product group at GitLab. You will drive commitments and sequencing with peer engineering leaders, Product, Infrastructure, and Security — much of it asynchronously, across time zones, in public issues and merge requests.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>How success is measured</strong></span></h2> <ul> <li>Customer Organizations running on cells in production, migrated cleanly and on schedule.</li> <li>Availability and latency improvements attributable to isolation and load distribution.</li> <li>Infrastructure cost per unit of capacity trending down as the footprint grows.</li> <li>Throughput and retention of the teams you build.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="font-size: 14pt;">What you will bring</span></h2> <p><strong>Engineering leadership at director scale</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience leading multiple teams through managers (roughly 25–60 engineers), including hiring and developing managers.</li> <li>A track record of shipping multi-quarter infrastructure programs with hard external dependencies — the kind where the hardest problem is sequencing across ten teams, not writing the code.</li> <li>Comfort operating as a peer to VPs and staff-plus engineers: you can hold an architectural position on technical merit and change it when the evidence changes.</li> <li>Strong written communication. GitLab is remote and asynchronous by default; influence here is exercised in documents.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Distributed systems depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have built and operated large-scale distributed systems in production — multi-tenant SaaS, sharded or cell-based architectures, control planes, or data platforms at comparable scale.</li> <li>Working fluency in relational database scaling (partitioning, sharding, replication), data migration at scale, and request routing.</li> <li>Real operational experience: incident command, capacity planning, and designing for blast-radius containment.</li> <li>Cloud infrastructure at depth on at least one major provider, ideally more than one.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI-native engineering</strong></p> <ul> <li>You understand what agentic access patterns do to a platform's read volume, concurrency, and authorization model, and you design for that rather than retrofitting it.</li> <li>You use AI tooling in your own engineering practice and have raised the bar for it across a team.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>
